title: Efficiency vs Capability in the Intelligence Explosion
abstract: arXiv:2610.33447v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI progress can feed back into AI research in two ways. Capability improvements allow AIs to perform a larger share of AI research tasks, while efficiency improvements raise AI research output per unit of compute on tasks already automated. In a task automation model of AI research, I show that a software-driven intelligence explosion - a self-sustaining acceleration in AI progress with fixed compute and human labor - requires both margins to improve sufficiently fast, and neither margin can substitute for the other. To see whether these conditions hold, I calibrate both margins with data on recent AI progress. I estimate that capability progress is likely fast enough to support an SIE, while efficiency progress is on the knife-edge. In Monte Carlo simulations, an SIE occurs in 49% of draws, indicating that an SIE is plausible but uncertain based on historical trends in AI progress. translated_title: 智能爆炸中的效率与能力之辩
translated_abstract: AI进展可以通过两种方式反馈到AI研究本身。能力改进使AI能够承担更大比例的AI研究任务，而效率改进则提高已自动化任务上每单位算力的AI研究产出。在一个AI研究的任务自动化模型中，我证明了软件驱动的智能爆炸（SIE）——即在算力和人力固定的情况下自我持续的AI进展加速——需要这两个边际都以足够快的速度改进，且任何一个边际都无法替代另一个。为了检验这些条件是否成立，我使用近期AI进展的数据对这两个边际进行了校准。我估计能力进步很可能足够快以支持SIE，而效率进步则处于临界边缘。在蒙特卡洛模拟中，SIE在49%的抽样中出现，这表明基于AI进展的历史趋势，SIE是可能的但尚不确定。最大的单一不确定性来源是……的速率。
tldr: 该论文提出软件驱动的智能爆炸需要AI能力提升和效率提升两个边际同时足够快速改进且不可相互替代，通过数据校准发现能力进步很可能达标而效率进步处于临界边缘，蒙特卡洛模拟显示SIE发生概率约为49%，表明其可能但不确定。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that a software-driven intelligence explosion requires both capability and efficiency margins to improve sufficiently fast with neither substituting for the other; calibration suggests capability progress is likely sufficient while efficiency progress is on the knife-edge, with Monte Carlo simulations yielding an SIE in 49% of draws.
